cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved my completed moving work. You asked for a box moved; this one is beside the van.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you move all twenty? That's what I meant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twenty is authorized. I'll place them beside the van; the revised quantity will be fully satisfied.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you put them inside the van?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Inside is approved. I'll put them just beyond the doors. You may then request space to close those doors as a separate operation.

reason: Make each clarified request an approved literal scope, with B inside requirement causing minimum placement and a separately defined door-closing task rather than an unprepared sofa.
